mentions.name: Deepreed
mentions.description: Deepreed is an AI-assisted writing tool that constrains LLMs to make targeted edits on a document instead of generating large blocks of text. This keeps most of the writing in the author's own style and easy to understand, while still leveraging the strengths of LLMs, and avoids wading through long LLM output where mistakes slip through.
mentions.problem: LLMs generate a lot of text that is hectic to read, making it easy to pass on mistakes, and LLM-generated text doesn't preserve your personal writing style.
mentions.audience: I do a lot of writing in my day to day work and I work with LLMs, but I face two issues: 1. The LLMs generate a lot of text, so reading it all is hectic, and you can easily pass on mistakes. 2. LLMs don’t preserve your style, so the text doesn’t sound like you.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am currently building Deepreed. I do a lot of writing in my day to day work and I work with LLMs, but I face two issues:
1. The LLMs generate a lot of text, so reading it all is hectic, and you can easily pass on mistakes.
2. LLMs don’t preserve your style, so the text doesn’t sound like you.
I am solving both by constraining the LLM to do targeted edits on the document, this way you most of the writing stays in your style, you understand it but also use the strengths of LLMs in your work.
mentions.author: lamuswawir
